criteria.criterion: With `agent.gate-review = copilot`: `vloop run` prints `  ! agent.gate-review is copilot: experimental (docs/guide/configuration.md)` and goes ahead; `vloop doctor` prints `! agent.gate-review is copilot: experimental (docs/guide/configuration.md)` and the copilot and copilot login rows. This holds whatever `run.verify` says.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go copilotKeys adds agent.gate-review unconditionally; run.go:193 prints the warning row; TestDoctorCopilotGateReviewExperimental runs with run.verify=false and checks doctor and preflight output

criteria.criterion: `vloop run` with `agent.gate-review = copilot` (from the file or `VLOOP_AGENT_GATE_REVIEW`) and `model.gate-review` at its default refuses before any session, exit 1: `vloop: agent.gate-review is copilot but model.gate-review is the default "sonnet", a Claude alias: set model.gate-review to a Copilot model id`.
criteria.evidence: run.go preflight loops over copilotKeys and builds the model.* key; TestRunPreflightRefusesDefaultGateReviewModel asserts the exact text

criteria.criterion: With `agent.gate-review = copilot`, a project skill directory under `.claude/skills/` or `.github/skills/` named like one of vloop's skills stops `vloop run` with K1's message (`vloop: .claude/skills/gate-review has the name of vloop's gate-review skill; a copilot session may load it instead — rename it`), exit 1, no session, and is an error row in doctor. No new warning is added for look-alike gate-review names; the `review` warning keeps its condition and message (`may be loaded instead of /vloop:review by a copilot session`), and so now shows with only the gate review on copilot.
criteria.evidence: skillClashes is unchanged and runs whenever copilotKeys is non-empty; TestCopilotGateReviewSkillWithPluginNameStopsTheRun checks the doctor error row and the preflight message; the review warning code is untouched and runs under doctorCopilot

criteria.criterion: With `agent.gate-review = copilot`, no GitHub login reaching the sessions refuses the run naming `agent.gate-review` (`vloop: agent.gate-review is copilot but no GitHub login reaches its sessions: …`), exit 1, and is doctor's copilot login error row; copilot missing or `copilot --version` failing is doctor's copilot error row and stops the run.
criteria.evidence: run.go uses keys[0] in the login refusal; TestCopilotGateReviewLoginRefusal asserts the message and the copilot login problem row; doctorCopilot's copilot row is shared with the other phases and the preflight turns a problem row into a refusal

criteria.criterion: With `agent.gate-review = claude` none of this appears, and a project skill named `gate-review` stops nothing. The checks for agent.work, agent.review, agent.second-review and agent.verify keep their words and behaviour.
criteria.evidence: TestGateReviewOnClaudeSaysNothing covers doctor and preflight with a gate-review skill present; the other keys' code is untouched apart from the added gate-review branch

criteria.criterion: Committed tests cover the warning, the model.gate-review refusal, K1, the login refusal and the claude case for agent.gate-review (extending the existing doctor and run preflight tests); a code comment that lists the Copilot phases or keys (doctor's experimental warning and copilotKeys included) names gate-review too.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor_copilot_gatereview_test.go has five tests, one per case, reusing the existing doctor test helpers; the comments on copilotExperimental, copilotKeys and doctorCopilot name gate-review, and the comments in agent_copilot.go and fence.go already did

notes: The new tests are in a new file rather than added to the existing test files. That is a placement choice and not a finding. The doctorCopilot comment now has one long line, which is cosmetic.
